assumptions.downstream_policy: compound_obligation.v1 pit near horizon if unmet

ising.convention: x=(1-Z)/2 ; Z=+1 for bit0, Z=-1 for bit1
ising.s_Q_definition: max(1, max|h_i|, max|J_ij|) excluding constant, including penalties

milp.licence_note: SciPy/HiGHS are free/open-source; no paid solver used

qubo.convention: E_Q(x)=offset + sum_{i<=j} Q[i,j] x_i x_j ; x in {0,1}; upper+diag
qubo.decision_objective_note: physical seconds require restoring C_centered via direct scorer; do not drop offset

penalty.rule: M = B/v_min + margin (strict), v_min=1 for one-hot binary violation measure
